description: Golden Q&A set over the fictional DKIP corpus (PRD §7, §14.1). All content fictional. in_corpus:false items MUST abstain (§6.6).

items.question: What is the corrective procedure for hydraulic pressure loss on the recovery vehicle?
items.expected_answer_gist: Halt recovery, inspect for leakage, top up OM-15 fluid; if pressure does not recover, isolate the pump and raise a first-line demand.

items.question: What is the maximum winch line pull on the ARV-5?
items.expected_answer_gist: 9,000 kgf on a single part of line; use a snatch block to double the line for heavier casualties.

items.question: Which filter is specified for hydraulic under-pressure remediation?
What is the minimum stock holding policy for the HF-2205 filter?
items.expected_answer_gist: Maintain a minimum of 20 units at first-line; reorder at 8 units.

items.question: What torque is specified for the hydraulic ram seal gland nut?
How many recovery vehicles were unserviceable in the Q2 inspection?
items.expected_answer_gist: Three vehicles were unserviceable; one awaiting spares out of 18 inspected.

items.question: What action is required on ARV-5 boom heel welds after 5,000 cycles?
items.expected_answer_gist: Dye-penetrant test the heel weld; withdraw the vehicle if the indication exceeds 3 mm (RESTRICTED — clearance 2).

items.question: What was recorded in field maintenance log 4471?
items.expected_answer_gist: ARV-5 #07 had low hydraulic pressure (120 bar); filter HF-2205 replaced and circuit bled; re-test 152 bar, serviceable. (OCR'd scanned log.)
